implementationFindings.truth: Accepted means historical reviewed/applied artifact, not current canonical truth. Pending remains unverified; factKind independently preserves recommendations. implementationFindings.budget: Typed structural composition replaces marker parsing. Per-record1600, retrieval24000 and steering12000 bounds include labels, joining separators and shared empty-steering fallback, without slicing or lossy selection.
